# Motokah

> Motokah is a vehicle marketplace for East Africa (Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia), aggregating dealer inventory and letting buyers search by city, make, price and body type.

Motokah Africa Limited operates the platform under license from 1Point Solutions.
